inclusions.bus_sgd_per_bus_km: Full resource cost per scheduled revenue bus-km, 2026 SGD excl. GST = BCM operator fee + LTA bus capital + LTA depot capital. Operator fee (contract value, LTA tender prices / scheduled bus-km from LTA published headways x 350 days, CPI to 2026): low 4.63 (Sembawang-Yishun 2020 bid, 365 days), central 5.24 (Seletar 2024 award, the package of the Yishun feeders), high 6.05 (Tampines 2025 award, 335 days). Fee includes bus captains and staff, bus maintenance, fuel (indexed), depot and interchange O&M, overheads, margin, pre-operation costs and an undisclosed lease charge for LTA assets; excludes indexation after the bid, incentives, service variations. Bus capital: e-bus prices 2025 (SD 425k, blend 487k, DD 580k, 2026 SGD), 17-yr statutory life, residual 0, r = 2 / 3.5 / 7 %, 75.0k / 53.0k / 43.7k km per bus-year -> 0.40 / 0.73 / 1.36 per km. Depot capital: LTA multi-storey depot contracts 585k / 696k / 786k per bus space (2026 SGD), life 50 / 40 / 30 yrs -> 0.25 / 0.62 / 1.45 per km. Land, fare/fleet systems (~0.1/km) and LTA overheads excluded. Use the operator-fee-only values (4.6 / 5.2 / 6.0) for a 'payments by LTA' view; they may also avoid double counting if the lease charge recovers asset depreciation. Apply either per bus-km or per bus-hour, never both. low_cost here is the low cost value; note that for B(ii) a low bus cost means a SMALLER avoidable saving.
